0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, 3-4 and on a three-game winning streak, host the 1-6 Utah Jazz, who have lost five straight, in the eighth game of the Pelicans' 2026-27 season. The Pelicans are 11th in the West and fifth in the Southwest, 3.5 games back, while the Jazz are 14th in the West and fifth in the Northwest, 4.5 games back. Utah won the last meeting 120-119 in Salt Lake City on October 23, 2026, leaving the Pelicans trailing 0-1 this season after they swept the 2025-26 series 3-0. New Orleans is missing Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Mo Bamba day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision.
